name: HookRun Webhook Action Engine
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook action engine; YAML routing, token/HMAC/IP checks, command and script execution, forwarding, retries and hot reload; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires an operator-managed server and TLS/reverse proxy. Webhook-triggered shell commands can be dangerous: validate signatures, restrict privileges and isolate scripts; hosting and network costs are separate.
